from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper in the collection as parsed from its text."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from the document summaries) that this paper references in its bibliography or text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
